known.why:
Show today's long local date above the main heading.
On the phone (Android, Expo Go) the screen when it failed is .aios3/phone/ac-streakly-today-rows-1.png: open it to see what a person would see there.

Make the default colour visibly selected when the empty add form opens.
On the phone (Android, Expo Go) the screen when it failed is .aios3/phone/ac-streakly-add-habit-from-empty-1.png: open it to see what a person would see there.

Show the habit's saved colour as selected when its edit form opens.
On the phone (Android, Expo Go) the screen when it failed is .aios3/phone/ac-streakly-edit-habit-filled-1.png: open it to see what a person would see there.

Deleting a habit must clear its remembered failed tick and remove the related save-error banner from Today.
On the phone (Android, Expo Go) the screen when it failed is .aios3/phone/ac-streakly-delete-habit-clears-failed-1.png: open it to see what a person would see there.

When an expired retry is refused, clear the remembered change and dismiss its save-error banner.
On the phone (Android, Expo Go) the screen when it failed is .aios3/phone/ac-streakly-failed-tick-kept-expired-1.png: open it to see what a person would see there.
